caption: The drawing shows a weather vane mounted on a greenish, patina-tinted rooftop structure. The weather vane has a vertical metal rod topped with a decorative, spiked finial. Below the finial is an arrow pointing horizontally with a broad feathered tail on one side, and a simple pointed arrowhead on the other; the arrow portion is colored in shades of copper and brown. Below the arrow, the rod supports a ring with the directional letters "N," "E," "S," and "W" affixed to it in a metallic brown color, indicating north, east, south, and west, respectively. Decorative scrollwork details extend from the ring supporting the directionals. The rooftop base is drawn in shades of pale green with bluish shadows and is depicted with angular overlapping panels. The background is a plain, off-white color, and there is a faint rectangular border framing the drawing.
title: Weather Vane
